title: Massive fire engulfs warehouse, multiple homes in Allentown on Wednesday night
text:
A major fire erupted in Allentown on Wednesday night, engulfing a vacant warehouse and multiple homes.
An old warehouse and surrounding homes were engulfed in flames on Wednesday night. NBC10 Team Coverage on the story. The fire appears to have engulfed a vacant old furniture factory on the block, but police also said on social media that the fire included multiple homes.
Flames were spotted on some of the surrounding homes, and firefighters were seen going around the area searching for people or flames. People around the fire have been told to evacuate and people have been told to avoid non-essential travel to the area. Just after 11 p.m., fire crews appeared to have the gotten the fire settled down, but there were still embers and lots of smoke spotted by SkyForce10.
According to NBC10 First Alert Meteorologist Robert Johnson, the air quality in the area is not compromised. But if people are close to the fire, their situation will be different.also showed that there were around 3,500 customers without power as of 10:15 p.m. in Allentown, but that number had reduced to around 2,100 at 11:05 p.m.
